{{Article header|eyebrow=EDFM // Field Procedure|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to Juri Ishmaak — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[Juri Ishmaak]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[Juri Ishmaak]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Juri Ishmaak]]'s Engineer services at Pater's Memorial in Giryak.

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' Juri Ishmaak is discovered through [[Felicity Farseer]].
* '''Invitation:''' Current Engineer data requires you to claim '''more than 50 Federal combat bonds'''.
* Reach '''Grade 3 access and at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Felicity Farseer]].
* Provide the required value of Federal combat bonds to Juri.
}}
== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Reach '''Grade 3 access and at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Felicity Farseer]].
# Receive Felicity's referral to Juri Ishmaak.
# Claim more than '''50 Federal combat bonds'''.
# Retain enough Federal combat bonds to satisfy Juri's credit-value hand-in.
# Travel to '''Pater's Memorial''' on '''Giryak 2 a''' in Giryak.
# Provide the required value of Federal combat bonds to Juri.
# Enter the Engineer workshop and begin increasing your reputation with Juri.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Juri Ishmaak]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
